window.basis: Previous alerts-part cutoff through current source-check cutoff.

sources_checked.name: GCN Circulars
sources_checked.result: All nine in-window Circular bodies screened; 46354–46355 were older-GRB refined optical limits and 46359 a stellar-flare confirmation; six event groups selected from 46356–46358 and 46360–46362.

sources_checked.name: Astronomer's Telegram
sources_checked.result: 18167 selected; 18168 concerned comet outbursts outside the astroparticle-alert priority.

sources_checked.name: IceCube Gold/Bronze
sources_checked.result: Checked for new or revised public track alerts; IceCube-261123A follow-up grouped with the existing event.

sources_checked.name: IceCube Cascade and neutrino–EM tables
sources_checked.result: Checked legacy public tables; these are not complete modern Kafka ledgers.

sources_checked.name: Swift/BAT GUANO
sources_checked.result: Checked queue through the cutoff; several 24 November Fermi/CALET triggers and IceCube-261123A still showed analyses/products pending.

sources_checked.name: Fermi GBM trigger resources
sources_checked.result: Checked current trigger-resource state and GCN follow-ups; the catalogue page lagged the latest trigger queue.

sources_checked.name: GraceDB public latest
sources_checked.result: Public latest view checked; direct API enumeration unavailable in this run and modern/private test streams not treated as astrophysical alerts.

sources_checked.name: KM3NeT
sources_checked.result: Official current pages and targeted searches checked; no complete public real-time alert ledger was available.

sources_checked.name: Ground arrays and cosmic-ray facilities
sources_checked.result: Targeted searches performed; legacy HAWC/AMON sources are not complete current ledgers.

selected.reason: Refined X-ray timing/spectrum and new optical limits with a conditional high-redshift inference.
New optical follow-up of an existing Bronze candidate.
New preliminary GBM duration and prompt-spectrum measurements.
New GRM duration, morphology and fluence.
Record daily LAT state with spectral hardening.

not_selected.reason: Refined optical non-detections for 8 November bursts; scientifically valid but incremental and outside the current event window.
Additional confirmation of the already classified stellar flare; no astroparticle implication.
Comet outbursts outside the report's astroparticle-alert priorities.

gaps: Direct GraceDB API enumeration was inaccessible; only the public latest view was checked.
Modern Kafka notices and full probability-map streams were not exhaustively enumerated.
Several new Swift/BAT GUANO entries remained pending at the cutoff.
Legacy HAWC/AMON tables and public KM3NeT pages are not complete real-time alert ledgers.
notes: Observation times and report times are kept separate.
Counterpart non-detections are treated as finite-depth, finite-field measurements rather than absence of a source.
No alert association was inferred from sky/time coincidence alone.
